scientific_hypothesis.statement: Exact-score shape contains predictive information in the strictly pre-match shot opportunity process variance that is absent from a fixed score kernel. The predictive variance of future goals can be decomposed from prior shot Bernoulli variance plus between-match xG opportunity variance and injected as a mean-preserving extra-Poisson goal-count state before enforcing already-frozen total-goal and 1X2 semantics.

shot_state.chronology: ONLY source matches with kickoff strictly earlier than target kickoff; same-kickoff matches are excluded

per_source_statistics.lambda_match: sum shot xG in one historical source-side match
per_source_statistics.bernoulli_variance_match: sum xG*(1-xG) over shots in that historical source-side match

shot_state.source_combination: equal arithmetic mean of the attack-source Fano and opponent-defense-source Fano after each source independently applies the fallback hierarchy
shot_state.underdispersion_policy: F_effective=max(1,F_estimated); this family tests only extra-Poisson opportunity uncertainty and is exactly Poisson-neutral below one

goal_count_generator.mean_anchor: home and away expected-goal means are computed directly from the frozen V3.1.1 baseline 225-cell matrix
goal_count_generator.distribution: Poisson when F_effective=1; otherwise moment-matched Negative Binomial with k=mu/(F_effective-1), preserving mean mu and variance F_effective*mu
goal_count_generator.support: same finite goal support as frozen baseline matrix; probability above final support cell is folded into the last marginal bin for the reference measure only
goal_count_generator.joint_reference: outer product of the generated home and away goal-count marginals

constraint_projection.purpose: constraint enforcement only, not a candidate transport family
constraints: preserve every frozen V3.1.1 total-goals marginal exactly
preserve frozen V3.2.4 target H/D/A probabilities exactly
constraint_projection.algorithm: deterministic iterative proportional fitting alternating total-goal slices and H/D/A partitions

application_scope.non_switch_matches: H/D/A remains frozen V3.1.1 while score shape may change through the new generative reference
application_scope.v3_2_4_switch_matches: H/D/A equals frozen V3.2.4 target while score shape comes from the new generative reference

forbidden: changing the Fano formula after scoring
using result labels to fit the shot-state parameters
manual match team league fold score or cell exceptions
